notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). NBIM's row gives voting 1.71% and ownership 0.59% for Berkshire Hathaway; we use the ownership figure as published. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. Class basis: Berkshire's Class A and Class B are not economically equal (a Class B share has 1/1,500 of a Class A share's dividend and distribution rights), so this is CalPERS's Class B holding as a share of Class B only, using the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 28, 2026 (the same count used in the marketcap lens). CalPERS also reported 571 Class A shares (CUSIP 084670108, value $426,539,855), not included here. Holders of record: Class B (BRK.B) only; Class A has approximately 950 record holders.
